div.head: II Cn 23
div.ab: ⁊ ne beo ænig man æniges teames wyrðe, butan he getrywe witnesse hæbbe, hwanan him come þæt him man æt befehþ.
And ne beo ænig man æniges teames wyrþe, buton he getrywe wittenesse habbe, hwanan him come þæt him man æt befehþ.
Et non sit quisquam alicuius aduocationis dignus, nisi credibile testimonium habeat, unde uenerit ei quod cum eo deprehenditur.
Ne beo ænig man æniges teames wyrþe, buton he habbe treowe gewitnysse hwanon him cóme þæt him mon æt befehð.
And ne beo ænig man æniges teames wyrðe butan he getrywe witnesse hæbbe, hwanan him come þæt him man æt befehþ.

Und niemand sei [im Anefang verklagt] zu einem Gewährzug berechtigt, wenn er nicht glaubwürdige Zeugenschaft hat, woher ihm das [Werthstück] zugekommen sei, welches bei ihm im Anefang angeschlagen wird.
And let no one [sued by attachment] be entitled to any vouching to warranty unless he has trustworthy witness as to where what is attached in his possession came to him from.
And no man shall be entitled to vouch to warranty, unless he has trustworthy witnesses [to declare] whence he acquired the stock which is attached in his possession.
And no man is to be entitled to vouch to warranty unless he has trustworthy witness as to where he obtained what is being attached.
And no one shall be entitled to vouch to warranty unless he has reliable witnesses to the manner by which he came by the goods in his possession.
